title: Sign here—the shuttle is waiting
scenario: At rental-car return, an employee says a fresh wheel scratch will cost €480 unless you accept a €120 “rapid settlement” before the airport shuttle leaves. They want a signature on a tablet immediately.

answers.A: Ask a second employee or manager to inspect the damage before you sign anything.
answers.B: Accept the cheaper settlement so you do not miss your flight, then challenge it after you get home.
answers.C: Photograph the car, ask for the damage record and contract reference, and dispute or settle through the rental company’s official process.

explanation: Time pressure at return is real, but signing can remove leverage. Preserve evidence and make the charge traceable through the company process.
proTip: Your flight clock should not become someone else’s signature clock.
